content:
Twelve South earlier this year launched a new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal belongings tray."

Twelve South has now expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller option featuring MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The original Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, giving you room to place your phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. However, the new Valet has been significantly reduced in size to 4.25 inches.

Here's how Twelve South describes the premium design of the Valet:

Designed as a "refined home accessory" first, the Valet is a precision wireless charger that blends warm materials with modern precision craftsmanship, creating a calmer, more intentional silhouette that fits anywhere in the home—from an entryway table to the kitchen or nightstand. The soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has plenty of power to charge your iPhone. It also includes an additional USB-C port for charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather tray
  • Four configurable placement options
  • Interchangeable, removable leather frame
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with built-in cable management
  • Additional USB-C port providing up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power supply and 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for pre-order at $129.99, offered in three different color combinations. It's not cheap, but as a place to charge your phone while holding your glasses, wallet, or keys, it's truly a pleasure to look at.
